sentences.text: Neutral Citation No. - 2024:AHC-LKO:80620 Court No. - 20 Case :- APPLICATION U/S 482 No. - 11029 of 2024 Applicant :- S. Zeeshan Haider And Another Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Addl. Chief Secy. Deptt. Home Lko.

And Another Counsel for Applicant :- Atul Kumar Mishra,Ashish Kumar Singh Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Arvind Singh Sangwan,J.
Prayer in this application is for quashing the impugned chargesheet dated 08.10.2019 filed against the applicants in Case Crime No. 0165/2019 under Sections 498A/323/504/506, I.P.C. and Section Dowry Prohibition Act, P.S. Saadatganj, District Lucknow, and also the entire proceedings arising therefrom.

Learned counsel for the applicant at the very outset submits that on a previous occasion also a similar F.I.R. was registered in which the matter was amicably settled and the informant started living with the applicant, however, she again left her home and got registered the impugned F.I.R.

Learned State Counsel has raised a preliminary objection that the applicant has been declared a proclaimed offender in proceedings under Section 82, Cr.P.C., as he has not put in appearance before the trial court.
S. Zeeshan Haider And Another vs State Of U.P. Thru. Addl. Chief Secy.

sentences.text: In reply, learned counsel for the applicant submits that in order to show his bona fide he is ready to bring a demand-draft of Rs. 50,000.00 favouring the victim-wife, as he is ready to appear before the Mediation and Conciliation Center of this court to explore the possibility of some amicable settlement.
List this case on 16.1.2025 as fresh.

In the meantime, the applicant will appear before the trial court on 16.12.2024 alongwith the demand-draft of Rs. 50,000.00 favouring his wife-victim, Anjum Rizvi, and will handover the same to her and on handing over the demand draft to the wife-victim the trial court will accept his bail and surety bonds.
The parties will also appear before the Mediation and Conciliation Center on 07.01.2025 for mediation proceedings.
In case, the petitioner fails to handover the demand-draft, as aforesaid, before the trial court, his bail and sureties will not be accepted.

(Arvind Singh Sangwan, J.) Order Date :- 4.12.2024 A.Nigam  S. Zeeshan Haider And Another vs State Of U.P. Thru. Addl. Chief Secy. ... on 4 December, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/70657625/
